modular-monolith.reason: Default until distribution pressure is proven.

layered.reason: Fits request/response apps with clear delivery/application/domain/persistence flow.

clean-architecture.reason: Useful when policy should be testable apart from frameworks, database, or web.

event-driven.reason: Fits async workflows, fan-out, ingestion, notifications, and integrations.

microkernel.reason: Use only if the product has a stable core plus plugin/extensions shape.

microservices.reason: Needs scaling, isolation, ownership, security, or release-cadence evidence.

space-based.reason: Only for extreme throughput/concurrency where central persistence is the bottleneck.
